title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the predictions of a model will change if we use a different training dataset. It is related to the complexity of the model.

title: Effect of Removing a Feature
text: When you remove a feature from a model, you are simplifying the model. How does this simplification affect the model's variance?

title: Simplification and Variance
text: Simplifying a model by removing features generally leads to a decrease in model variance because there are fewer parameters to estimate.
